items.title: Khadi & Village Industries: From Tradition to Enterprise
items.summary: 13 OCT 2026 11:12AM by PIB Delhi A charkha spinning in a village once spoke of nationalism. Today, that spirit is taking new shape through a growing ecosystem of rural enterprises. Honey, herbal products, banana fibre, textiles and other village industries are creating new possibilities for traditional skills. The spirit of self-reliance continues to resonate with the vision of Vocal for Local and Atmanirbhar Bharat.

facts.text: In 2025–26, sales of Khadi and Village Industries products reached a historic ₹1.87lakh crore, the highest level recorded (as of May 2026).
Compared with 2013–14, sales grew by 501%, while production increased by 380% to ₹1,25,296 crore.
Employment in the sector increased by 56% to 2.04 crore.
It rose from ₹4 per hank in 2013–14 to ₹15 per hank currently, an increase of approximately 275%.
